input: immutable weighted fusion grid, same eligible COLMAP point IDs and actual measured tracks; raw point/camera priors
scope: jointly optimize relative camera poses and one shared 3D point per eligible COLMAP track; write shared points only to previously eligible grid positions; no dense propagation, new matching, intrinsic fitting or training
gauge: first raw pose fixed exactly; raw/anchor XYZ priors fix arbitrary scale and world frame; all remaining poses regularized
normalization: median positive source-camera raw Z over previously eligible anchor grid points; no GT

residuals.raw_prior_weight: same w_raw as fusion per grid point
residuals.classical_prior_weight: one alpha*w_col per unique COLMAP point; alpha frozen fusion strength; duplicate observations do not duplicate this prior
residuals.reprojection_weight: w_col per actual track observation; measured uv mapped to raw native pixel centers
residuals.robust_loss: soft_l1 f_scale=1 applied to all normalized scalar residuals
residuals.cheirality: soft barrier z>=0.0001*normalization with sigma=0.001*normalization; reject output with any nonpositive observation Z

solver.method: scipy least_squares trf, sparse two-point Jacobian and lsmr

acceptance: positive solver success status, finite parameters and residuals, objective nonincrease, positive depths; otherwise exact pre-optimization fallback, preserving attempted parameters and outputs
fallback: upstream fusion fallback/no eligible anchors/insufficient constraints/solver budget or failure -> byte-identical pre-optimization XYZ and unchanged cameras
initialization: one arithmetic mean of previously fused grid positions per shared track; initial-only grouping is a reported comparator, not counted as solver benefit
fit: maximize dev macro F1@2mm, ties first candidate; raw/fused/grouped-initial comparisons; never tune on test or automatically enable
evaluation: inherit fixed DTU split and previous 200000 original indices/STL cap/ROI/1,2,5mm metrics. Same raw-camera-to-GT Sim3 for every point version; separately evaluate poses and fixed-frame camera center errors; never refit GT point alignment to optimized camera changes
